Your door handles are touched hundreds of times every single day. The factory plastic handles on most Corolla variants look plain and cheap over time. These carbon fiber trims cover them completely — making every door handle in your Corolla look like a premium, luxury upgrade without any permanent modification.

Why 8 Pieces and Not 4?

Most door handle trim sets only cover one part of the handle. This complete 8-piece set covers the full door handle area on all 4 doors — both the pull handle and the surrounding trim panel. The result is a uniform, complete carbon fiber look across your entire interior that looks truly factory-quality rather than a partial afterthought upgrade.

  1. Clean all 4 door handle areas thoroughly with dry cloth or alcohol wipe
  2. Peel the 3M adhesive backing from each trim piece
  3. Align each piece carefully over the door handle area

Is installation permanent?

No — the 3M adhesive is strong but the trims can be carefully removed without damage to the original door handles if needed. They are completely reversible.

The set covers different parts of the 4 door handles so some pieces may be slightly different shapes to fit each door panel correctly — but they all share the same premium carbon fiber texture for a uniform look throughout the cabin.
